source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U03: Distinguish securitisation, reconstruction and conditional security enforcement

facts.statement: The Act provides frameworks for securitisation, reconstruction, security-interest enforcement and registry. Enforcement is against secured assets and subject to statutory conditions/exclusions; it is not a power over every asset of every debtor.

payload.title: Choose the legal task before the remedy
payload.core_explanation_md:
A stressed account can raise several different tasks. An acquisition of financial assets from an originator relates to securitisation; acquiring the relevant rights for realisation relates to asset reconstruction. Enforcing an existing security interest is a different task again. The Central Registry supports the recording framework; registration is not itself payment of the debt.

SARFAESI provides a statutory enforcement route with conditions, safeguards and exclusions. The possibility of acting without first obtaining a civil-court decree does not give an unrestricted right to seize anything owned by a debtor. Establish the creditor, debt, security, applicable asset and procedure before choosing the route.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an unpaid debt alone establish a power to seize any debtor property under SARFAESI?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The secured relationship, asset and statutory conditions must be established.

payload.stem_md: A recovery plan treats an uncharged family asset and a charged business asset as interchangeable merely because the borrower owns both. What is the central defect?

options.text_md: Statutory security enforcement concerns the relevant secured asset, subject to the applicable conditions
options.explanation_md: Ownership by a debtor does not alone create a security interest in favour of the creditor.

options.text_md: The two assets must always have identical market values
options.explanation_md: Value does not establish the legal security relationship.

options.text_md: A charged business asset can never be a secured asset
options.explanation_md: A valid charge can supply the required relationship, subject to the law.

options.text_md: A bank can create security retrospectively by recording an NPA
options.explanation_md: Asset classification does not itself create a missing security agreement.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Ownership by a debtor does not alone create a security interest in favour of the creditor.

payload.stem_md: An analyst records an acquisition of loan receivables by an ARC as proof that every loan has already been recovered in cash. Which distinction corrects the entry?

options.text_md: Acquisition and recovery are always the same accounting event
options.explanation_md: A transfer of rights is not proof of collection from the obligor.
The statutory concept expressly extends to debt and receivables.

options.text_md: Acquiring financial-asset rights and realising the amounts due are separate events
options.explanation_md: Reconstruction/acquisition changes rights; recovery still depends on actual realisation.

options.text_md: Only the Central Registry can receive borrower repayments
options.explanation_md: The registry records transactions; it is not the universal repayment recipient.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Reconstruction/acquisition changes rights; recovery still depends on actual realisation.
